items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, and we all know about Zooty and Sid, but nobody seems to mention Kaiser.

ctx.x: No, he's from Augusta, Georgia. He was a Georgia boy. Yeah, his mother lived in Texas, but he was from Augusta, Georgia; that's where Kaiser was from.
Yeah, and we all know about Zooty and Sid, but nobody seems to mention Kaiser.
